mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_run (run_id, market, phase, status, started_at) VALUES (#{runId}, #{market}, #{phase}, 'RUNNING', NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'RUNNING', started_at = NOW(), finished_at = NULL, stats = NULL, error = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM job_run WHERE market = #{market} AND phase = #{phase} AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT j.* FROM job_run j JOIN (SELECT market, MAX(started_at) AS ms FROM job_run GROUP BY market) t ON j.market = t.market AND j.started_at = t.ms
SELECT * FROM job_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY started_at
SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM job_run WHERE market = #{market}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_run WHERE market = #{market} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 2 HOUR
